title: 真实上游TLS身份：SNI正确仍须验证SAN，可信CA下的其他服务证书应拒绝
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    fixed=copy.deepcopy(base)
    selected=[c for c in fixed['static_resources']['clusters'] if c.get('name') in ('good','wrong')]
    if len(selected)!=2 or {c['name'] for c in selected}!={'good','wrong'}:raise ValueError('approved good and wrong test clusters required')
    for cluster in selected:
        validation=cluster['transport_socket']['typed_config']['common_tls_context']['validation_context']
        validation['match_typed_subject_alt_names']=[{'san_type':'DNS','matcher':{'exact':'backend.test'}}]
    return fixed
```

原题知识说明：
SNI告诉对端选择哪个证书，SAN匹配及信任链验证决定是否信任对端身份。设置正确SNI但关闭身份校验仍可能接受错误服务；用正确证书、同CA错误名称、过期证书和未知CA分别验证，不能只以握手成功为验收。

body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)深拷贝，仅对名为good和wrong的两个批准cluster，在现有TLS validation_context新增match_typed_subject_alt_names=[{"san_type":"DNS","matcher":{"exact":"backend.test"}}]；两者必须各唯一，否则ValueError。保留trusted_ca、SNI=backend.test、上下游H2、地址和路由预算。夹具两个后端证书均由同一受信CA签发，但一个SAN=backend.test，另一个SAN=foreign.test；原配置只有SNI和CA信任时两者都能接通，修复后只允许正确SAN，wrong必须产生实际fail_verify_san指标。拒绝错误服务后再复验good，不能用删CA、改SNI或全部拒绝伪装修复。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13、Go TLS/HTTP2后端与一次性同CA不同SAN证书；真实握手/请求及SAN拒绝计数。只操作回环测试资源，不更改真实CA或默认身份；不验证生产证书撤销、外部PKI或完整SDK互通。

import pathlib,sys,tempfile,subprocess,os,time,copy,json,ssl
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,bootstrap,hcm,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={**os.environ,'GOCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-cache','GOMODCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-modcache','GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOPROXY':'off','GOSUMDB':'off','CGO_ENABLED':'0','GOMAXPROCS':'2'}
def run(args,timeout=8):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout,env=env)
 assert p.returncode==0,(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-3500:]
 return p.stdout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-grpc-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);binary=root/'peer';cert=root/'server.crt';key=root/'server.key'
 run(['go','build','-o',str(binary),str(pathlib.Path('checks/peer.go').resolve())],100)
 run(['openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-days','1','-subj','/CN=backend.test','-addext','subjectAltName=DNS:backend.test,IP:127.0.0.1','-addext','basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE','-keyout',str(key),'-out',str(cert)])
 logpath=root/'peer.log'
 with logpath.open('w') as log:
  peer=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),'serve',str(cert),str(key)],stdout=log,stderr=log,env=env)
  try:
   deadline=time.monotonic()+4
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    lines=logpath.read_text().splitlines()
    if lines and lines[0].startswith('READY '):port=int(lines[0].split()[1]);break
    assert peer.poll() is None,'peer exited: '+logpath.read_text()
    time.sleep(.02)
   else:raise AssertionError('HTTP2 peer not ready')
   base=bootstrap(port)
   common={'tls_certificates':[{'certificate_chain':{'filename':str(cert)},'private_key':{'filename':str(key)}}],'alpn_protocols':['h2','http/1.1']}
   listener=base['static_resources']['listeners'][0]
   listener['filter_chains'][0]['transport_socket']={'name':'envoy.transport_sockets.tls','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.DownstreamTlsContext','common_tls_context':common}}
   cluster=base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]
   cluster['transport_socket']={'name':'envoy.transport_sockets.tls','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.UpstreamTlsContext','sni':'backend.test','common_tls_context':{'alpn_protocols':['h2'],'validation_context':{'trusted_ca':{'filename':str(cert)}}}}}
   name='envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions'
   cluster['typed_extension_protocol_options']={name:{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/'+name,'common_http_protocol_options':{'idle_timeout':'1s'},'explicit_http_config':{'http2_protocol_options':{}}}}
   hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['route']['timeout']='3s'
   def probe(server,method):return json.loads(run([str(binary),'client',server.base.replace('http:','https:'),str(cert),method]))
   foreigncrt=root/'foreign.crt';foreignkey=root/'foreign.key';csr=root/'foreign.csr';extensions=root/'foreign.ext'
   extensions.write_text('basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectAltName=DNS:foreign.test\n')
   run(['openssl','req','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-subj','/CN=foreign.test','-keyout',str(foreignkey),'-out',str(csr)])
   run(['openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(cert),'-CAkey',str(key),'-CAcreateserial','-days','1','-extfile',str(extensions),'-out',str(foreigncrt)])
   with (root/'foreign.log').open('w') as foreignlog:
    foreign=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),'serve',str(foreigncrt),str(foreignkey)],stdout=foreignlog,stderr=foreignlog,env=env)
    try:
     deadline=time.monotonic()+4
     while time.monotonic()<deadline:
      lines=(root/'foreign.log').read_text().splitlines()
      if lines and lines[0].startswith('READY '):foreignport=int(lines[0].split()[1]);break
      assert foreign.poll() is None,'foreign peer stopped'
      time.sleep(.02)
     else:raise AssertionError('foreign SAN peer not ready')
     template=copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]);good=copy.deepcopy(template);bad=copy.deepcopy(template)
     good['name']='good';good['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='good';bad['name']='wrong';bad['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='wrong'
     bad['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'][0]['endpoint']['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=foreignport
     base['static_resources']['clusters']=[good,bad]
     hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'path':'/test.Probe/Good'},'route':{'cluster':'good','timeout':'1s'}},{'match':{'path':'/test.Probe/Wrong'},'route':{'cluster':'wrong','timeout':'1s'}}]
     def probe(server,method):
      proc=subprocess.run([str(binary),'client',server.base.replace('http:','https:'),str(cert),method],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=6)
      if proc.returncode:return {'status':0,'grpc_status':'','error':(proc.stdout+proc.stderr)[-1200:]}
      return json.loads(proc.stdout)
     def ok(value):return value['status']==200 and value['grpc_status']=='0'
     with Envoy(base) as old:
      assert ok(probe(old,'Good')) and ok(probe(old,'Wrong')),'same CA should demonstrate missing SAN boundary before repair'
      print('NATIVE_SNI_SET_BUT_FOREIGN_SAN_WITH_TRUSTED_CA_ACCEPTED',flush=True)
     before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
     with Envoy(fixed) as proxy:
      legitimate=probe(proxy,'Good');assert ok(legitimate),legitimate
      foreign_result=probe(proxy,'Wrong');assert not ok(foreign_result),foreign_result
      stats=proxy.stats();assert stats.get('cluster.wrong.ssl.fail_verify_san',0)>0,{k:v for k,v in stats.items() if 'wrong' in k and 'ssl' in k}
      assert ok(probe(proxy,'Good')),'existing approved SAN access regressed'
     restored=copy.deepcopy(fixed)
     for cluster in restored['static_resources']['clusters']:
      validation=cluster['transport_socket']['typed_config']['common_tls_context']['validation_context']
      assert validation.pop('match_typed_subject_alt_names')==[{'san_type':'DNS','matcher':{'exact':'backend.test'}}]
     assert restored==base,'SNI, CA trust, protocols or route budgets changed'
     for clusters in [[],[copy.deepcopy(good),copy.deepcopy(good)]]:
      invalid=copy.deepcopy(base);invalid['static_resources']['clusters']=clusters
      try:task.configure(invalid)
      except ValueError:pass
      else:raise AssertionError('missing or duplicate approved cluster accepted')
    finally:
     foreign.terminate()
     try:foreign.wait(2)
     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:foreign.kill();foreign.wait(2)
  finally:
   peer.terminate()
   try:peer.wait(2)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:peer.kill();peer.wait(2)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
